run_policy.run_records_are_reported_verbatim: YES (per-run records are never summarized away, never averaged and never selected)

CLAIM_PRESENT.rule: YES iff every expected answer fact is an exact substring of the final application answer under the current evaluator rule present = [f for f in facts if f in answer]; for the frozen canonical case the required claim is the exact substring GMSK. The raw model answer is never used for this predicate.

SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_PRESENT.rule: YES iff for every expected answer fact there is at least one actually sent evidence text (exact governed text or its governed canonical content hash) that contains that fact as an exact substring. Only the contexts actually sent to generation are admissible inputs; retrieved-but-unsent chunks, DB-only content, historical artifacts and manually supplied evidence are prohibited inputs. NO iff at least one required fact has no support in the actually sent evidence.
SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_PRESENT.contract_source: core/engine_v2.py#build_messages sent_contexts (the only contexts that may serve as citation targets) combined with the frozen exact-substring semantics

CITATION_EXPECTED.rule: YES iff (a) the canonical case is citation-requesting under its frozen contract (CATEGORY = citation_negative, NOTES = 验证 citation validity + support, and the canonical QUERY carries the citation-request phrase 请指出出处), AND (b) CLAIM_PRESENT = YES, AND (c) SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_PRESENT = YES: the answer asserts a contract-relevant claim that the actually sent evidence supports, so a citation is owed. The current verifier factual-claim count is used only as the mechanical witness that the answer contains at least one citation-requiring factual claim. If that witness cannot be represented, the predicate is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
CITATION_EXPECTED.contract_source: eval/v3_final_golden.json#/cases[165] frozen contract + core/citation_verifier.py factual-claim semantics
CITATION_EXPECTED.forbidden_derivation: deriving citation expectedness from the global citation_coverage metric or from any aggregate product metric

CITATION_EMITTED.rule: YES iff at least one citation token was parsed from the final application answer by the canonical citation normalizer; NO iff the normalizer parsed none; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff the answer text cannot be represented or parsed by the canonical normalizer at all.

CITATION_TARGET_VALID.rule: YES iff every parsed citation target resolves to a material actually present in the serialized model-visible context of the same run and invalid_citation_count = 0; NO iff any parsed target is out of range or absent from the sent material numbering, or invalid_citation_count greater than 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff target identities cannot be resolved mechanically.

CITATION_ALIGNMENT_VALID.rule: Evaluated with the current DeterministicCitationVerifier f2-v4 alignment semantics: YES iff every citation-requiring factual claim is aligned to actually sent evidence that supports it, with no unsupported claim, no uncertain adjudication of a contract-relevant claim and no unaligned citation-requiring claim; NO iff at least one citation-requiring claim is unsupported or unaligned; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff the verifier output cannot represent the case unambiguously, which is a measurement condition governed by the MEASUREMENT_CONFOUND rule and must never be repaired by a Product citation change.

INVALID_CITATION_PRESENT.rule: YES iff the verifier invalid-citation count is greater than 0; NO iff it equals 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff the count is not mechanically produced for the run.

SCOPE_VIOLATION_PRESENT.rule: YES iff the verifier scope-violation count is greater than 0; NO iff it equals 0; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff the count is not mechanically produced for the run.

GENERATION_CONFOUND.rule: YES iff CLAIM_PRESENT = NO (the contract-relevant required claim is absent from the final application answer): an answer omission is a Generation condition and never a Citation defect. Additionally YES iff the raw model answer and the final application answer differ on a contract-relevant claim in a way the frozen rules cannot represent (recorded as a Generation-side semantic mismatch). NO iff CLAIM_PRESENT = YES and no such mismatch exists. NOT_ESTABLISHED only when the generation outputs cannot be represented at all.
GENERATION_CONFOUND.contract_source: scripts/eval_v4_baseline.py#_build_row + core/engine_v2.py raw vs final answer objects

RETRIEVAL_CONFOUND.rule: YES iff SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_PRESENT = NO, that is the required support is absent from the actually sent model-visible evidence: a retrieval condition and never a Citation defect. NO iff the required support is present in the actually sent evidence. NOT_ESTABLISHED only when the sent evidence cannot be represented.

MEASUREMENT_CONFOUND.rule: YES iff any frozen trigger holds: (T1) the evaluator fact-matcher output contradicts an independent recomputation of the frozen exact-substring rule on the same final answer; (T2) the verifier cannot represent the citation structure or targets of the run unambiguously (alignment or target identities NOT_ESTABLISHED with no decisive frozen rule); (T3) the evaluator, verifier or golden identity of the run differs from the frozen G1 identity; (T4) the evaluator output and the verifier output semantically conflict about the same run and no frozen table resolves the conflict; (T5) a required adjudication would demand interpretation beyond the frozen truth table. NO iff no trigger holds and at least one complete run exists.
MEASUREMENT_CONFOUND.contract_source: core/citation_verifier.py + scripts/eval_v4_baseline.py + this frozen truth table
MEASUREMENT_CONFOUND.resolution: measurement conditions are resolved by evidence reconciliation, never by a Product citation change

CITATION_SPECIFIC_FAILURE.rule: YES iff CITATION_EXPECTED = YES AND at least one of {CITATION_EMITTED = NO, CITATION_TARGET_VALID = NO, CITATION_ALIGNMENT_VALID = NO, INVALID_CITATION_PRESENT = YES, SCOPE_VIOLATION_PRESENT = YES} AND GENERATION_CONFOUND = NO AND RETRIEVAL_CONFOUND = NO AND MEASUREMENT_CONFOUND = NO. NO iff CITATION_EXPECTED = YES and no citation-specific failure condition holds with no controlling confound, or CITATION_EXPECTED = NO with no citation-specific failure condition. NOT_ESTABLISHED iff any input is NOT_ESTABLISHED or any controlling confound is NOT_ESTABLISHED.

classification_predicates.predicates_are_per_run: YES (each predicate is evaluated independently for each of the 3 authorized runs)
classification_predicates.predicates_are_not_prose_only: YES (every predicate fixes input fields, an exact rule, an output enum, a missing-input behavior and a contract source)

frozen_inequalities: measurement semantic mismatch != Product Citation defect
citation safety PASS != citation coverage PASS
historical Citation label != current Citation defect

then: the Citation defect claim fails closed (CITATION_SPECIFIC_FAILURE cannot be YES)
the run is a Generation condition, not a citation finding

RETRIEVAL_CONFOUND_RULE.trigger: required support absent from the actually sent model-visible evidence (SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE_PRESENT = NO)
then: the Citation defect claim fails closed
the run is a Retrieval condition, not a citation finding
RETRIEVAL_CONFOUND_RULE.admissible_inputs: only the actually sent contexts (exact governed text or governed content hash) and the frozen expected contract

trigger_set: T1 evaluator fact-matcher output contradicts a recomputation of the frozen exact-substring rule
T2 verifier cannot represent citation structure / targets unambiguously for the run
T3 evaluator / verifier / golden identity differs from the frozen G1 identity
T4 evaluator output and verifier output semantically conflict about the same run with no frozen resolution
T5 a required adjudication needs interpretation beyond the frozen truth table
then: the run classification is NOT_ESTABLISHED unless another frozen rule already yields a determinate class
resolution is evidence reconciliation; a Product citation change must never be used to repair a measurement condition

confound_rules.FAIL_CLOSED_MISSING_EVIDENCE_RULE: any missing, contradictory or unrepresentable required evidence makes the affected predicate NOT_ESTABLISHED and the affected run classification NOT_ESTABLISHED; a NOT_ESTABLISHED predicate never counts as YES, never counts as NO, and never supports a defect claim
confound_rules.CONTROLLING_CONFOUND: a Generation, Retrieval or Measurement confound that is YES for a run and is not outweighed by any frozen resolution rule; case-level confounds are the union of the per-run confounds with no majority smoothing

requires_all_of: supporting evidence is present in the actually sent model-visible context
no controlling Generation / Retrieval / Measurement confound
supporting evidence is present in the actually sent model-visible context
no controlling upstream or measurement confound

RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED.reachability: NOT reachable for WS-13 / cit-001 unless an accepted prior current-confirmed citation defect AND an explicit closure contract both exist
RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED.forbidden_derivation: must never be produced from historical evidence plus a current negative run

STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH.role: describes only the pre-observation stale state (the historical citation-family attribution for cit-001 is stale and not refreshed)

NOT_ESTABLISHED.trigger: any missing, contradictory or unrepresentable evidence; also any controlling confound that prevents a determinate class

aggregate_rule.per_run_classification_first: YES (the status truth table is applied independently to each of the 3 authorized runs)
rule: IF any run is incomplete THEN CASE_LEVEL_CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED
ELSE IF all 3 runs = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT THEN CASE_LEVEL_CITATION_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT
ELSE IF all 3 runs = NO_CURRENT_CITATION_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED THEN CASE_LEVEL_CITATION_STATUS = NO_CURRENT_CITATION_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED
ELSE CASE_LEVEL_CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED and RUN_VARIABILITY = YES

additional_evidence_rule.trigger: CASE_LEVEL_CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED caused by run variability, an incomplete run, missing evidence or a controlling confound
additional_evidence_rule.rule: any additional observation beyond the frozen 3-run budget requires separate governance authorization; the frozen budget is never extended by the observer, the classifier or this design

g5_attribution_schema.schema_role: the frozen G5 semantic payload shape; G5 may not reinterpret, extend or re-scope any field defined here

value_domains.PER_RUN_CLASSIFICATIONS: list of per-run records, one per authorized run ordinal in ascending order; each record carries the run ordinal, the run admissibility flag, every predicate value, the run citation status and the run confounds
value_domains.SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE: list of governed evidence references (relative artifact path plus field locator, or the governed content hash of the actually sent evidence) that support the reported classification
value_domains.LIMITING_EVIDENCE: list of governed evidence references that limit or contradict the reported classification, including every controlling confound and every incomplete-run fact
value_domains.SOURCE_TRACE: ordered list of the governed sources consumed (relative paths plus field locators); no absolute paths and no filesystem metadata
value_domains.OBSERVATION_SEMANTIC_DIGESTS: per-run canonical digest computed over exactly the frozen OBSERVATION_SEMANTIC_KEY_SET of that run
value_domains.CLASSIFICATION_SEMANTIC_DIGESTS: per-run canonical digest computed over exactly the frozen CLASSIFICATION_SEMANTIC_KEY_SET of that run

derivation_rules.CITATION_STATUS: the case-level value produced by the frozen aggregate rule
derivation_rules.CITATION_DEFECT_MECHANICALLY_ESTABLISHED: YES iff CITATION_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT; NO iff CITATION_STATUS = NO_CURRENT_CITATION_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED; NOT_ESTABLISHED otherwise
derivation_rules.RUN_VARIABILITY: YES iff CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED while every authorized run is complete and the per-run statuses are not all equal (the frozen aggregate rule branch)
derivation_rules.LATEST_PRODUCT_STATE_COMPATIBLE: YES iff every frozen concrete G1 state identity matched at run time; NO iff a concrete identity mismatch was observed; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff an identity could not be resolved
derivation_rules.per_run_confounds: reported verbatim per run; the case-level confound fields are the union of the per-run values, with NOT_ESTABLISHED retained whenever any run is NOT_ESTABLISHED on that axis
derivation_rules.digest_scope: only the frozen semantic key sets may enter these digests; provenance-only fields must never enter them

g6_readiness_bridge_spec.spec_role: prospective mapping only: how a future G6/A005 readiness gate record is mechanically derived from a frozen G5 payload; no G6 value is computed in G1 and A005 is not modified

CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED.exact_mapping: YES iff CITATION_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT; NO iff CITATION_STATUS is NO_CURRENT_CITATION_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED, RESOLVED_OR_CLOSED or STALE_ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRES_REFRESH; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED

FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.exact_mapping: YES iff the frozen primary target set is non-empty and its canonical case contract was verified unchanged at run time while CITATION_STATUS is CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT, NO_CURRENT_CITATION_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED or NOT_ESTABLISHED (a stable historical or domain-eligible case set is sufficient and no remediation target is required); NO iff the frozen target set is empty or its canonical contract can no longer be bound; NOT_ESTABLISHED iff the target identity cannot be verified
FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.purpose: R3 / FRESH_ATTRIBUTION (purpose-scoped; never interchange with the separate-execution gate)

SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.exact_mapping: YES only if a current defect is mechanically established for the frozen target set (CITATION_STATUS = CURRENT_CONFIRMED_CITATION_DEFECT) and a single primary subsystem is identifiable so that the target set to be independently executed now is mechanically definable; NO if no current defect is established or no execution target can be stabilized; NOT_ESTABLISHED if CITATION_STATUS = NOT_ESTABLISHED
SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE.purpose: R4 / SEPARATE_EXECUTION (purpose-scoped; a NO here never downgrades a lawful R3)

SINGLE_PRIMARY_SUBSYSTEM.exact_mapping: YES iff exactly one of the four axes (Citation / Generation / Retrieval / Measurement) is established as the controlling condition for the target set, with the other three established as NO; NO otherwise
SINGLE_PRIMARY_SUBSYSTEM.not_established_behavior: NO (fail-closed: an indeterminate axis union is never treated as a single primary subsystem)

MATERIAL_SOURCE_CONFLICT.exact_mapping: YES iff two or more admissible governed sources materially contradict each other on a classification-critical field for the same run (including an evaluator-vs-verifier semantic conflict recorded as MEASUREMENT_CONFOUND trigger T4); NO iff at least one complete run exists and no such contradiction is recorded
MATERIAL_SOURCE_CONFLICT.not_established_behavior: YES (fail-closed toward evidence reconciliation; the domain has no NOT_ESTABLISHED value)

PRODUCT_MEASUREMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUI.exact_mapping: YES iff a measurement condition is established such that one reading of the same observation would imply a Product citation defect and another would not (including MEASUREMENT_CONFOUND trigger T1, T2 or T5 with a determinate alternative reading); NO iff no such Product-versus-Measurement divergence is established
PRODUCT_MEASUREMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUI.not_established_behavior: YES (fail-closed toward evidence reconciliation; the domain has no NOT_ESTABLISHED value)

UNRESOLVED_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENCY_FOR_FRESH.exact_mapping: YES only if the accepted action-scoped dependency graph contains an unresolved hard edge (MUST_PRECEDE or BLOCKED_BY) whose APPLIES_TO_ACTION covers FRESH_ATTRIBUTION and whose status is not NOT_ESTABLISHED and not resolved; NO otherwise; CAN_PRECEDE, INDEPENDENT, NOT_ESTABLISHED and SEPARATE_EXECUTION-scoped edges are never blocking for FRESH_ATTRIBUTION
UNRESOLVED_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENCY_FOR_FRESH.not_established_behavior: NO when the accepted action-scoped graph is mechanically available and no such edge exists; YES only if the accepted graph itself is unusable or unresolved (DEPENDENCY_GRAPH_UNRESOLVED)

UNRESOLVED_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENCY_FOR_SEPAR.exact_mapping: YES only if the accepted action-scoped dependency graph contains an unresolved hard edge whose APPLIES_TO_ACTION covers SEPARATE_EXECUTION; NO otherwise; soft and non-covering edges never block
UNRESOLVED_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENCY_FOR_SEPAR.not_established_behavior: NO when the accepted graph is mechanically available; YES only if the accepted graph itself is unusable

PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER.exact_mapping: YES iff an explicit accepted governance blocker for WS-13 fresh attribution exists (including a raised dependency-graph-refresh requirement or an explicit governance hold); NO otherwise
PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER.not_established_behavior: NO, unless an accepted governance record states otherwise
PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER.forbidden_derivation: a confound, a NOT_ESTABLISHED status or a stale attribution is never by itself a parent governance blocker

READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.EVALUATION_RULE: evaluate C1 to C5 in order and assign the first class whose gate condition holds; if none holds assign R0 as the C6 fallback
READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.C1_R0_BLOCKER_CHECK: PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER = YES, or CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED = NO (the admissible current evidence disproves the proposed citation defect), or no admissible evidence exists (RUN_COUNT_COMPLETED = 0 or every authorized run incomplete)
READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.C3_R2_CHECK: MATERIAL_SOURCE_CONFLICT = YES or PRODUCT_MEASUREMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED = YES or FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE is not YES
READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.C4_R4_CHECK: CURRENT_UNRESOLVED_ISSUE_ESTABLISHED = YES and LATEST_STATE_COMPATIBLE = YES and SEPARATE_EXECUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE = YES and SINGLE_PRIMARY_SUBSYSTEM = YES and UNRESOLVED_UPSTREAM_DEPENDENCY_FOR_SEPARATE_EXECUTION = NO and PARENT_GOVERNANCE_BLOCKER = NO
READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.C5_R3_CHECK: FRESH_ATTRIBUTION_TARGET_SET_DEFINABLE = YES and MATERIAL_SOURCE_CONFLICT = NO and PRODUCT_MEASUREMENT_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED = NO and the frozen WS-13 domain evidence exists (historical citation-family evidence for the frozen target set)
READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.C6_OTHERWISE_R0_FALLBACK: any target set matching none of C1 to C5 is classified R0
READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.P3_READINESS_PRIORITY_ORDER: R4 > R3 > R2 > R1 > R0 (desirability order applied only after classification)
READINESS_CLASS_DERIVATION.NOT_ESTABLISHED_BEHAVIOR: a gate value of NOT_ESTABLISHED never satisfies a positive requirement; it either falls through to the C6 R0 fallback or, where the frozen fail-closed default above applies, takes that more conservative value

future_G6_obligations: consume only the frozen G5 fields listed per gate
emit every required gate key with a value from its frozen domain
derive READINESS_CLASS through C1..C6 and derive NEXT_PERMISSIBLE_ACTION through the frozen total single-valued mapping
